responses.reason: The mid-cycle convention must preserve the asynchronous reset exception: areset assertion takes effect immediately and drives predict_history to 0 even mid-cycle.
responses.spec_quote: areset is a positive edge triggered asynchronous reset that resets the history counter to zero.

edits.value: Optional mid-cycle input changes occur after sampling and before the next sampled edge; they are used only for the next row/edge and do not change the already sampled predict_history, except an asynchronous areset assertion takes effect immediately and drives predict_history to 0.
